data.name: Sonoo
data.gender_notes: Sonoo is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sonit' meaning 'sound', 'Sono' meaning 'sweet'. The name Sonoo is often given to girls born in the month of Jyestha (May-June) as it is believed to bring happiness, prosperity and good fortune to the child. The name Sonoo carries the meaning “Sweet Sound” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Sonoo usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet sound and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the sweetness of life and the melodious sound of the soul. It represents the beauty of nature and the grace of the divine.
data.etymology: Sonoo belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sweet Sound.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sonoo total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
